parsed.text: Panel p0 holds fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Copied prior records (current) are not new estimates; candidate command records (k0,k1,k2) are conditional alternatives and are not events that have occurred. Current distributions: at n0 blue peaks are the four cells (0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3) and red peaks are the four cells (0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1). Nodes n1–n3 current distributions are uniform for both roles. Candidate differences: k0 is uniform at all nodes; k1 concentrates at n0 with blue peak (0,2) and red peak (0,0) while leaving other nodes uniform; k2 places the same n0 2×2 peaks as current (blue top-right 2×2, red top-left 2×2) and is uniform elsewhere.
